strategy.name: v90_meta_confidence
strategy.note: Two-sided meta-labeler: causal features -> XGBoost LONG/SHORT heads on triple-barrier labels (purged K-fold) -> isotonic-calibrated confidence -> BUY/SELL/FLAT. Raw score drives decision; calibrated probability is the honest confidence. Params/labels frozen before OOS; artifacts from tools/train_v90_meta_confidence.py.

default_operating_point.name: balanced_top5
default_operating_point.justification: Pre-hoc rule, not chosen by eyeballing holdout results across candidates: first operating point, in the fixed order active_top10 -> balanced_top5 -> selective_top2 -> sniper_top1, satisfying ALL of n>100, positive avg net return/trade, and a Wilson-95%-lower-bound within reach of 50%. balanced_top5 (n=111, +0.17%/trade, Wilson95=[45.7%,63.9%]) is the first to clear all three; active_top10 (n=320) fails on positive-expectancy (-0.05%/trade, PF 0.94); selective_top2 (n=34) and sniper_top1 (n=11) fail on n>100. Full derivation in thresholds.json:shipped_default_operating_point and MODEL.md.
default_operating_point.other_points: active_top10, selective_top2, and sniper_top1 remain reported in results.json and MODEL.md for transparency. They are explicitly NOT the shipped default -- do not treat them as validated production operating points.

provenance.notes: Bit-identical port of the booster/feature/calibration artifacts. Two fixes applied to the ported copy only (Sharpe-artifact removal for n<50, and this default-operating-point justification); source repo left untouched. See MODEL.md 'Fixes applied during port'.
